name: Eleazar
summary: Aaron's son, who took his father's place as priest. He served beside Moses and then Joshua, and helped divide the land of Canaan among the tribes.

key_moments.title: Wearing Aaron's Garments
key_moments.description: On Mount Hor, Moses took Aaron's garments and put them on Eleazar before Aaron died. Then Moses and Eleazar left the mountain together.

key_moments.title: Joshua Commissioned
key_moments.description: Moses stood Joshua before Eleazar and all the people and laid his hands on him. Eleazar would seek the LORD's guidance for Joshua through the Urim.

key_moments.title: Dividing the Land
key_moments.description: Eleazar the priest, Joshua and the heads of the tribes handed out Canaan as each tribe's inheritance.
